builtins.semantics: Number of cluster cores minus 1. GAP9 GCC folds it to (-mPE value - 1): 7 with -mPE=8, 3 with -mPE=4, usable in static initializers. Without -mPE it reads the core count from the cluster peripheral (li 0x1a100000; p.lw 18(a0); addi -1).

builtins.notes: Wrapper gap_ncorem1 (Emulation/GapSystem.h:65); no SDK call site. Same mechanism as __builtin_pulp_CoreCount.
